about: A test map for lib/world.js in the Nether (stunts/_test_camera_world_nether.js, lib/hb/test/camera_world.test.js): one Nether place, as Saving Up for a Bastion claims it, with a test stamp.

portal_cottage_nether.name: The Nether below the Portal Cottage
portal_cottage_nether.about: NETHER DIMENSION (x, z are Nether coordinates: the Portal Cottage's cellar portal links here, Overworld / 8; unsurveyed). The portal that formed when Grandpa walked through on day ~175 stands on a netherrack shelf over a lava lake, under a netherrack cliff; the piglins of a bastion across the lake gather at it, because a gold ingot comes out of it every night (Grandma's). A player's barter tower (nether brick: a 7x7x4 base room with the output chest, a 3x3 column to about 11 high against the cliff, a 1x2 cell (the piglin's block under a downward dropper, a hopper beside it), a glass window facing west to the shelf, a catch hole on the cliff ledge chuting into the cell, a lava moat round the base) about 10 blocks east of the portal, finished day ~4998. From day ~4998 a baby piglin lives in the cell (Saving Up for a Bastion, day 5000); babies never grow up.
